planets.name: K2-90 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-90 with a 2.9-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-90 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-90. Its orbit and size follow Dressing et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
